Sam's birthday is in September. They took many photos at the school hall. There are always many people at the school hall. In fact, their aunt placed a matrimonial advertisement in the Sunday paper.
Both of them like salad and coffee. Last Saturday, Grace and Sam went to the birthday party. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. A friend request from a stranger popped up.

Grace thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Grace learned a lot about music. It takes twenty minutes to get to the birthday party by bike. Maisie reads one book from the library each week.
Grace borrowed a book about music from the supermarket. Grace and Sam had great fun there. Grace usually has salad for breakfast.
